$comment: labels.directions is "{name}: directions": the office's name comes first, so a renderer that strips the placeholder and appends the name draws ": directions Bristol studio" and fails (README "Labels"). The rest is one-office-open. context.now is Wednesday 07/10/2026 11:00 in Europe/London (BST, +01:00); the status is open under locations.json open-now step 2. "labels.status" is read as the label for the computed status (labels.open, labels.appointment or labels.closed); labels.directions, "Directions to {name}" with {name} replaced by the office name, is the aria-label of the directions link; the opening hours list only days with rows; contact links use the item phone as text, its tel: href per section#display-forms.
summary: One open office whose directions label puts the name first: "Bristol studio: directions".
